section.title: Community participation in a constitutional project
section.text: The Caddo Nation’s project account describes research followed by citizen surveys and meetings, then a planned 2026–2027 period of analysis, education and drafting. It presents consultation as part of deciding what constitutional changes to consider. Read this as the Nation’s dated account of an ongoing process. A plan to prepare proposals for a later vote does not show that changes were adopted or that all citizens agreed. This source does not replace the governing text and amendments.
